title: slopdesk configuration
description: Every setting slopdesk understands. Everything has a best-by-default answer; a key is only written here to disagree with it.

on-launch.description: Restore the last session or open a fresh window when the app starts.

redact-secrets.description: Mask likely secrets in window titles and notification bodies.

record-clipboard-history.description: Keep the clipboard ring the pane's paste history reads.

follow-session-focus.description: Follow the host's focused pane when another client moves it (docs/45 §8.2).

close-confirm-tab.description: When to confirm before closing a tab.

close-confirm-window.description: When to confirm before closing a window.

new-tab-position.description: Where a new tab lands in the strip.

auto-hide-tabs-panel.description: Whether the layout may take the tabs panel away when it is tight.

working-directory-new-window.description: Where a new WINDOW opens: `inherit`, `home`, or an absolute path.

working-directory-new-tab.description: Where a new TAB opens: `inherit`, `home`, or an absolute path.

working-directory-new-split.description: Where a new SPLIT opens: `inherit`, `home`, or an absolute path.

osc.description: Post the explicit OSC 9 / OSC 777 notifications a program asks for.

long-command.description: Post when a long-running command finishes.

on-finish.description: Post when any command exits cleanly.

on-error.description: Post when a command exits non-zero.

on-watch-finish.description: Post when an `slopdesk watch`-wrapped command finishes.

while-foreground.description: Whether a banner shows while slopdesk itself is frontmost.

bounce-dock.description: Bounce the Dock icon when a notification arrives and the app is not focused.

sound-shell-controlled.description: Let a `BEL` ring the system beep.

sound-on-error-exit.description: Beep when a command exits non-zero.

agent-task-complete.description: Post when a code agent finishes its task.

agent-await-input.description: Post when a code agent stops to ask something.

agent-sound-task-complete.description: Play a sound when a code agent finishes its task.

agent-sound-await-input.description: Play a sound when a code agent stops to ask something.

command-finish.description: Badge the tab when a command exits cleanly.

command-fail.description: Badge the tab when a command exits non-zero.

command-await-input.description: Badge the tab when a command stops at an interactive prompt.

busy-delay-seconds.description: Seconds a command must run before the busy dot shows. 0 shows it immediately.

agent-processing.description: Badge a pane while its code agent is working.

agent-complete.description: Badge a pane when its code agent finishes.

agent-awaiting-input.description: Badge a pane when its code agent is waiting on an answer.

pane-switcher-preview.description: Show the live pane preview while the switcher is held open.

copy-on-select.description: Copy the selection to the pasteboard as soon as it is made.

trim-trailing-spaces.description: Drop trailing spaces from each copied line.

paste-protection.description: Confirm before pasting text that carries a newline or a control byte.

mouse-hide-while-typing.description: Hide the pointer while typing until the mouse moves again.

focus-follows-mouse.description: Focus the pane under the pointer without a click.

scroll-multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to every scroll delta the terminal receives.

clear-selection-on-typing.description: Clear the selection as soon as a key is typed.

clear-selection-on-copy.description: Clear the selection once it has been copied.

shift-arrow-select.description: Let ⇧+arrow extend a selection instead of reaching the program.

paste-bracketed-safe.description: Strip the bracketed-paste terminators a pasted payload tries to smuggle in.

clipboard-read.description: What a program may do when it READS the clipboard through OSC 52.

clipboard-write.description: What a program may do when it WRITES the clipboard through OSC 52.

allow-mouse-capture.description: Let a program take the mouse (vim, tmux) instead of the terminal keeping it.

shift-click.description: Whether ⇧-click extends the selection or reaches the program that captured the mouse.

click-to-move.description: Move the shell's cursor to a click on the prompt line.

auto-secure-input.description: Turn on macOS secure input while a password prompt is on screen.

secure-input-indicator.description: Show the lock while secure input is on.

undo-at-prompt.description: Let ⌘Z undo the last edit on the prompt line.

right-click-action.description: What a plain right-click does. ⌃+right-click always opens the menu.

option-as-alt.description: Which ⌥ keys send ESC rather than composing a character.

command-prompt.description: Edit the command line in the app's own editor instead of the shell's readline.

link-detection.description: Underline URLs, paths and issue references under the pointer.

link-cmd-click.description: What ⌘-click does to a detected link.

link-cmd-shift-click.description: What ⌘⇧-click does to a detected link. Both actions happen on the HOST.

auto-detect-link-schemes.description: Whether every scheme is detected or only the custom list below.

hint-patterns.description: Extra regular expressions the hint overlay offers as jump targets.

hint-pattern-actions.description: What each `hint-patterns` entry does when it is chosen, positionally.

title-shell-controlled.description: Let a program set the pane title through OSC 0 / OSC 2.

clipboard-shell-controlled.description: Let a program reach the clipboard through OSC 52 at all.

size.description: Open at the remembered frame, at a cell grid, or at a pixel frame.

cols.description: How many columns a window opens at while `window.size` is `grid`.

rows.description: How many rows a window opens at while `window.size` is `grid`.

width-px.description: Width in points a `frame` window opens at.

height-px.description: Height in points a `frame` window opens at.

desktop-presentation.description: How a remote desktop window opens: in a window, fullscreen or borderless.

satellite-background-pointer.description: Let a satellite window move the remote pointer while it is not the key window.

density.description: How much room the chrome takes. Compact buys more rows.

dock-icon-animate-progress.description: Animate the Dock tile while a command runs.

dock-icon-error-badge.description: Badge the Dock tile when a command fails.

font-family-bold.description: The family drawn BOLD. Unset follows `font-family`'s own bold cut.

font-family-italic.description: The family drawn ITALIC. Unset follows `font-family`'s own italic cut.

font-family-bold-italic.description: The family drawn BOLD ITALIC. Unset follows `font-family`'s own cut.

font-family-fallback.description: Families tried, in order, for a character `font-family` cannot draw.

font-thicken.description: Stroke every glyph as well as filling it, so the face reads heavier.

font-thicken-strength.description: How hard `font-thicken` strokes. `0` is the lightest, not none.

font-size.description: Point size of the primary face.

line-height.description: Cell height: a named stop, or a raw multiplier like 1.15.

foreground.description: Terminal text colour, six hex digits.

cursor-style.description: Cursor silhouette: block, hollow block, bar or underline.

cursor-blink.description: Whether the cursor blinks. `default` leaves it to the program (DEC mode 12).

cursor-color.description: Cursor body colour as six hex digits. Empty follows the foreground.

cursor-text-color.description: Colour of the glyph under the cursor. Empty follows the background.

cursor-opacity.description: Cursor body opacity, 0 transparent through 1 opaque.

images.description: Draw inline images (kitty graphics). Off hides them; the terminal still stores them.

scrollback-limit.description: How many lines are kept above the viewport for scrollback.

prevent-sleep.description: Hold a sleep assertion on the HOST while any agent is working. Applies on reconnect.

resume-on-recovery.description: Re-arm a detached agent session when the connection recovers. Applies on reconnect.

qp-sharp.description: Sharpest constant QP on a clean link. Unset leaves the encoder's own. Reconnect.

qp-coarse.description: Coarsest QP under congestion. Unset leaves the encoder's own. Reconnect.

qp-decouple.description: Let min and max QP move apart so a static sidebar stays crisp. Reconnect.

fec-m.description: Reed–Solomon parity count. Must match on BOTH ends. Reconnect.

fec-k.description: Reed–Solomon group size, read only when `fec-m` is 2 or more. Both ends. Reconnect.

pacer.description: Present a decoded frame on arrival or hold it to a smoothness deadline. Reconnect.

playout-ms.description: Fixed playout buffer in ms. Setting it leaves adaptive playout. Reconnect.

capture-scale.description: Downscale factor applied to the captured desktop. Reconnect.

display-capture.description: Which SCStream filter the host captures with. Reconnect.

virtual-display.description: Render the remote desktop onto a HiDPI virtual display. Reconnect.

sharpen.description: Unsharp-mask strength on the luma channel, client side. 0 is off.

keybind.description: Chord to action, one per line: "cmd+t" = "new-tab".

env.description: Raw SLOPDESK_* overrides, applied last and above every typed key above.
